Real official documents from UMOA-Titres (https://www.umoatitres.org), retrieved 2026-10-04.
"Compte rendu" = compte rendu d'adjudication (official auction result report, 1-page PDF).
.txt files are `pdftotext -layout -enc UTF-8` output of the PDF (kept instead of the PDF to keep
fixtures small); the 2016 report is kept as the original PDF to exercise the PDF path.
